svg.title: Sub-hauler — continuous exploration map
svg.desc: One continuous cave network with four regions, four settlements, 24 main locations, eight hidden coves, and 42 physically drawn passages. Amber cutter gates, violet pressure gates and cyan thruster gates block specific passages. Depth increases downward; the high-pressure Glass Trench and Deep Anchor are lowest. All secrets are visible for design review.
svg.text: One connected world. New tools open new routes.
Depth increases downward · discover equipment in coves · descend through the pressure boundary
DEEPEST WATER / Deep Anchor, basalt & hidden jets
Find CUTTER → discover SEAL or THRUSTER in either order.
Seal opens deep water. Thruster opens jets, treasure and the return shortcut.
Repair the network → deliver the core to Deep Anchor → bring the dispatch home.
DESIGN MAP · All 42 passages are drawn continuously. Hidden rewards shown for review; spatial distances await playtesting.
